scope: Committed public source snapshot, not the local Git history. Historical commit IDs in research notes refer to local research history.

hash_scope.sha256: SHA-256 of file bytes emitted by git archive, including attribute conversion such as .ps1 CRLF. Checkout bytes can vary with Git attributes.
hash_scope.git_blob_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical source Git blob contents before archive or checkout attribute conversion; these are not Git object IDs.
